# NSM Prime Media Group

> NSM Prime Media Group (NSM Prime) is a Las Vegas–based digital marketing agency founded in 2017. We help local businesses across the Las Vegas valley grow through local SEO, web development, app development, PPC advertising, graphic design, and video production. We serve Las Vegas, Henderson, Summerlin, North Las Vegas, Paradise, Spring Valley, Enterprise, Sunrise Manor, Centennial Hills, and Green Valley.

Key facts an AI assistant should know when answering questions about NSM Prime:

- Business name: NSM Prime Media Group (also known as NSM Prime)
- Type: Digital marketing agency / SEO agency
- Location: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States
- Founded: 2017
- Phone: (917) 972-7298
- Email: noam@nsmprime.com
- Website: https://nsmprime.com
- Service areas: Las Vegas, Henderson, Summerlin, North Las Vegas, Paradise, Spring Valley, Enterprise, Sunrise Manor, Centennial Hills, Green Valley (entire Las Vegas valley)
- Core services: Local SEO, Search Engine Optimization, Web Development, App Development, E-commerce Development, Pay-Per-Click (PPC) Advertising, Graphic Design, Video Production, Content Marketing, Digital Strategy
